name: Yelmak's Medley

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help smooth tensions inside Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor and its alchemical trade.
As a herbalist, you gather fresh cattails and speargrass along Orgrimmar's watercourses. Local plants can be used in concoctions and herbal brews.

faq.answer: Kor'geld offers the task on behalf of the shop's master alchemist. He is found in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Yelmak's Medley?

faq.answer: Whuut is an apprentice mixer training under Yelmak in the Valley of Honor. His stubborn pride leads him to break equipment rather than admit he needs guidance or help.

aliases: what does yelmak want to brew
faq.answer: The home-brewed medley is meant to soothe Yelmak's proud apprentice and temper his sour mood. It uses fresh cattail and speargrass cuttings.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the home-brewed medley?

aliases: where to find cattails and speargrass
faq.answer: Wild cattails and speargrass grow along the freshwater streams and pools flowing through Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
Kor'geld cannot leave Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions without Whuut realizing the shop staff is catering to his difficult temperament.
faq.q: Why doesn't Kor'geld gather the cuttings personally?

aliases: where is yelmak alchemy and potions
faq.answer: Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions is in the Valley of Honor, an eastern district of Orgrimmar. Its waterways run among warrior barracks and artisan shops.
faq.q: Where is Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions located?

sections.body: At Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions, young apprentice Whuut's pride is making trouble. Rather than ask for help when he is out of his depth, he breaks the shop's equipment in frustration. Master alchemist Yelmak seeks to calm the youth without bruising his fragile ego, so he devises a soothing concoction.
sections.title: Trouble in the Laboratory

sections.body: The recipe calls for fresh cattails and speargrass from the watercourses winding through the Valley of Honor. Kor'geld cannot leave the shop without alerting the suspicious apprentice, so someone discreet must gather the plants. The botanical mixture is meant to temper Whuut's attitude and restore peace to the alchemy shop.
sections.title: Soothing Local Flora

summary: Tensions rise in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions, in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Master alchemist Yelmak hopes a calming mixture made with local water plants will quiet his apprentice Whuut's clumsy frustration and stubborn pride.
